name: stat-panel
title: Official Record Stat Panel
description: RHS 820px translucent 'official record' panel that slides over track-1 footage and lists disaster facts, ending on a counted death toll. The most-reused sub-comp in the show (28 uses).

name: title-card
title: Episode Title Card
description: Stacked centered title reveal: cold-open hook line, punch line, full episode title (Arial Black 128), and a Georgia-italic amber date/brand subline.

name: outro-brand
title: Warning Hour Brand Outro
description: Closing 'THE WARNING HOUR' wordmark card with episode-number line and CTA tag, fading to black.

name: numbers-rollup
title: Stacked Numbers Roll-up
description: Header plus up to four rows of counted big Courier New figures with caption labels, closing on a source citation.

name: bulletin-typewriter
title: NWS Bulletin Typewriter
description: Green-on-black CRT typewriter reconstruction of a verbatim government bulletin, typed phrase-by-phrase in sync with narration, blinking cursor, verbatim-source label.

name: ranked-bars
title: Ranked Row Comparison
description: Masthead plus up to 3 fill-animated ranked rails with counted numeric readouts, a scale axis with ticks, and a record badge + closing kicker on the winning row.

name: ef-ladder
title: EF-Scale Rung Ladder
description: Two-column explainer: damage-indicator tile grid building one at a time, plus a rating ladder of wind-speed rungs, closing on a verdict stamp and reasoning line. Note: ep4 has a richer damage-indicator/scale treatment (g-scale.html, g-fujita.html, g-metmap.html) not extracted here.

name: stat-timeline
title: Chronology Rail Strip
description: Horizontal chronology strip: title, a two-endpoint-year growing progress rail stalling on a percent readout, then sequential narration-order text beats. Closest available analog in the repo for a year-axis chronology strip; no true stepped-label multi-year timeline comp exists to extract from.

name: joplin-stat-panel
title: Joplin Stat Panel (worked example)
description: The stat-panel exemplar taken through the full pick-and-tweak flow for a real brief (Joplin 2011 casualty hit): search index, copy, hand-retune copy/counter, timings untouched. Reference for how library items become episode graphics.
params: derived from stat-panel.html — see that exemplar for the editable slots

name: moves-demo
title: Move library demo (roof panel throw)
description: 10 s worked example of moves.js: camera rig, arc throw, counter driven by the flight, shake, dust, measure-draw, clean exit. Copy moves.js inline; README lists every move.
params: see moves/README.md for each move's opts
